performance.verdict: Spend throttled intentionally; SOW blocker on intake seat is the real risk.

findings.text: Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 — 24 days overdue with no completed event logged; CRM automation readiness is unconfirmed.
Leads field reads 0 across all 28 days and the full 45-day series — GHL contacts (80) and 13 Google Ads conversions exist, but CPL is uncomputable; attribution chain is broken.

Spend is highly erratic: 9 zero-spend days in the last 28 days, including 2026-08-22 ($0) and a 3-day signal of $20.77 / $0 / $62.48 vs prior-3 avg of $16.50 — pattern is budget exhaustion mid-day, not a pull-back decision.
GBP actions fell 10% week-over-week (last reported: 115 over 28 days, 31 calls); Aug 19 spiked to 17 actions then collapsed to 0 for Aug 22–23 — directional softening despite paid being live.
GHL shows 42 opportunities created vs only 9 won (21% close rate) with $0 pipeline value recorded — opportunity value field is unpopulated, blocking any revenue-per-lead calculation.

suggestions.text: Fix lead attribution: reconcile 80 GHL contacts and 13 Google Ads conversions to populate the leads field and unlock CPL tracking.
suggestions.monday_update: The leads field has returned 0 for the entire 45-day series despite 80 GHL contacts and 13 Google Ads conversions existing in the same window — CPL is currently uncomputable. Action: trace the GHL-to-reporting connector and confirm which contact stage maps to a 'lead' event; populate or fix the field. Success check: leads field shows a non-zero value matching GHL contact volume within 3 days (by 2026-08-27). Until this is resolved, no budget scaling decision is defensible.

suggestions.text: Confirm who owns intake post-Vivian departure (7/7); verify GHL seat login and after-hours coverage before any budget increase.

Action: confirm with Xavier or Nader who owns dispatch intake now, verify their GHL login is active, and confirm after-hours coverage is live. Success check: a named owner with active GHL access is confirmed in writing by 2026-08-27. This is a SOW-listed ⛔ blocker on budget scale-up.
